_avail.description: 8x6 Seamless 4K Scaling Presentation Matrix Switcher - Preamp Output w/o Amplifier and Control Processor

ports.label: HDMI Input 1
ports.notes: HDMI 1.4, HDCP 1.4. Up to 4K @ 30Hz or UHD/4K @ 60Hz with 4:2:0 chroma subsampling. De-embedded audio (PCM only) feeds the audio matrix; multi-channel bitstream formats (Dolby Atmos, DTS-HD, etc.) pass through to HDMI outputs untouched.

ports.label: DTP/XTP Input 1
ports.notes: Configurable DTP or XTP RJ-45 input. DTP carries HDMI + embedded audio + analog audio + RS-232 + IR + remote power up to 330ft (100m) on shielded CATx; XTP mode adds digital embedded audio (no remote power). Shielded twisted pair required.

ports.label: DTP/XTP Input 2
ports.notes: Configurable DTP or XTP RJ-45 input. DTP carries HDMI + embedded audio + analog audio + RS-232 + IR + remote power up to 330ft (100m) on shielded CATx; XTP mode adds digital embedded audio (no remote power). Shielded twisted pair required.

ports.label: HDMI Output 1
ports.notes: Non-scaled HDMI matrix output (1.4, HDCP 1.4). Embedded audio mirrors video routing.

ports.label: HDMI Output 2
ports.notes: Non-scaled HDMI matrix output (1.4, HDCP 1.4). Embedded audio mirrors video routing.

ports.label: Scaled DTP/XTP/HDBT Output 1
ports.notes: Configurable DTP / XTP / HDBaseT output with Vector 4K seamless scaling. Carries HDMI + embedded audio + bidirectional RS-232 + IR over shielded CATx (DTP/XTP up to 330ft, HDBT mode up to 330ft).

ports.label: Scaled DTP/XTP/HDBT Output 2
ports.notes: Configurable DTP / XTP / HDBaseT output with Vector 4K seamless scaling. Carries HDMI + embedded audio + bidirectional RS-232 + IR over shielded CATx (DTP/XTP up to 330ft, HDBT mode up to 330ft).

ports.label: Scaled DTP/XTP/HDBT Output 3
ports.notes: Configurable DTP / XTP / HDBaseT output with Vector 4K seamless scaling. Carries HDMI + embedded audio + bidirectional RS-232 + IR over shielded CATx (DTP/XTP up to 330ft, HDBT mode up to 330ft).

ports.label: Scaled DTP/XTP/HDBT Output 4
ports.notes: Configurable DTP / XTP / HDBaseT output with Vector 4K seamless scaling. Carries HDMI + embedded audio + bidirectional RS-232 + IR over shielded CATx (DTP/XTP up to 330ft, HDBT mode up to 330ft).

ports.label: HDMI Out 1 (Mirror)
ports.notes: Buffered HDMI mirror of a scaled DTP output, for local monitoring. Same routing as the paired RJ-45 output (typically scaled outputs 5 and 6 in the panel labeling).; buffered mirror

ports.label: HDMI Out 2 (Mirror)
ports.notes: Buffered HDMI mirror of a scaled DTP output, for local monitoring. Same routing as the paired RJ-45 output (typically scaled outputs 5 and 6 in the panel labeling).; buffered mirror

ports.label: Audio Input 1 (Stereo Line)
ports.notes: Stereo balanced/unbalanced analog line-level input on 3.5mm 5-pole captive screw. +4dBu nominal, +21dBu max balanced. -18 to +24 dB input gain.

ports.label: Audio Input 2 (Stereo Line)
ports.notes: Stereo balanced/unbalanced analog line-level input on 3.5mm 5-pole captive screw. +4dBu nominal, +21dBu max balanced. -18 to +24 dB input gain.

ports.notes: Stereo balanced/unbalanced analog line-level input on 3.5mm 5-pole captive screw. +4dBu nominal, +21dBu max balanced. -18 to +24 dB input gain.

ports.notes: Stereo balanced/unbalanced analog line-level input on 3.5mm 5-pole captive screw. +4dBu nominal, +21dBu max balanced. -18 to +24 dB input gain.

ports.notes: Stereo balanced/unbalanced analog line-level input on 3.5mm 5-pole captive screw. +4dBu nominal, +21dBu max balanced. -18 to +24 dB input gain.

ports.label: Audio Input 6 (Stereo Line)

ports.label: Mic/Line Input 1
ports.notes: Mono mic/line balanced/unbalanced input on 3.5mm 3-pole captive screw. -60 dBV mic / +4 dBu line / -10 dBV consumer. -18 to +80 dB input gain. +48VDC switchable phantom power.

ports.label: Mic/Line Input 2
ports.notes: Mono mic/line balanced/unbalanced input on 3.5mm 3-pole captive screw. -60 dBV mic / +4 dBu line / -10 dBV consumer. -18 to +80 dB input gain. +48VDC switchable phantom power.

ports.label: Mic/Line Input 3
ports.notes: Mono mic/line balanced/unbalanced input on 3.5mm 3-pole captive screw. -60 dBV mic / +4 dBu line / -10 dBV consumer. -18 to +80 dB input gain. +48VDC switchable phantom power.

ports.label: Mic/Line Input 4
ports.notes: Mono mic/line balanced/unbalanced input on 3.5mm 3-pole captive screw. -60 dBV mic / +4 dBu line / -10 dBV consumer. -18 to +80 dB input gain. +48VDC switchable phantom power.

ports.label: Audio Output 1 (Stereo Line)
ports.notes: Variable stereo balanced/unbalanced analog line-level output on 3.5mm 5-pole captive screw. >+21 dBu max balanced, +15 dBu max unbalanced.

ports.label: Audio Output 2 (Stereo Line)
ports.notes: Variable stereo balanced/unbalanced analog line-level output on 3.5mm 5-pole captive screw. >+21 dBu max balanced, +15 dBu max unbalanced.

ports.label: Audio Output 3 (Stereo Line)
ports.notes: Variable stereo balanced/unbalanced analog line-level output on 3.5mm 5-pole captive screw. >+21 dBu max balanced, +15 dBu max unbalanced.

ports.label: Audio Output 4 (Stereo Line)
ports.notes: Variable stereo balanced/unbalanced analog line-level output on 3.5mm 5-pole captive screw. >+21 dBu max balanced, +15 dBu max unbalanced.

ports.label: S/PDIF Output
ports.notes: S/PDIF digital audio output on coaxial RCA. 75 ohm impedance.

ports.label: LAN (Switcher)
ports.notes: 10/100Base-T half/full-duplex Ethernet for switcher control + web UI + SIS protocol. Default 192.168.254.254. Independent from the IPCP control processor's Ethernet ports.

ports.label: RS-232 (Switcher)
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 control for the switcher matrix on 3.5mm 3-pole captive screw. 9600-115200 baud. Independent from any IPCP control-processor serial ports.

ports.label: RS-232 Pass-Thru TP Tx 1
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 over the DTP/XTP/HDBT TP link (to remote source-side endpoints). Pin 1=Tx, 2=Rx, 3=Gnd. Shares the same 5-pole captive with the matching IR pass-thru port (pins 4-5).

ports.label: RS-232 Pass-Thru TP Tx 2
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 over the DTP/XTP/HDBT TP link (to remote source-side endpoints). Pin 1=Tx, 2=Rx, 3=Gnd. Shares the same 5-pole captive with the matching IR pass-thru port (pins 4-5).

ports.label: RS-232 Pass-Thru TP Rx 1
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 over the DTP/XTP/HDBT TP link (to remote sink-side endpoints). Pin 1=Tx, 2=Rx, 3=Gnd. Shares the same 5-pole captive with the matching IR pass-thru port (pins 4-5).

ports.label: RS-232 Pass-Thru TP Rx 2
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 over the DTP/XTP/HDBT TP link (to remote sink-side endpoints). Pin 1=Tx, 2=Rx, 3=Gnd. Shares the same 5-pole captive with the matching IR pass-thru port (pins 4-5).

ports.label: IR Pass-Thru TP Tx 1
ports.notes: IR (TTL 0-5V, 30-60kHz) pass-through over the DTP/XTP/HDBT TP link (to remote source-side endpoints). Pin 3=Gnd, 4=IR Tx, 5=IR Rx. Shares the same 5-pole captive with the matching RS-232 pass-thru port (pins 1-3).

ports.label: IR Pass-Thru TP Tx 2
ports.notes: IR (TTL 0-5V, 30-60kHz) pass-through over the DTP/XTP/HDBT TP link (to remote source-side endpoints). Pin 3=Gnd, 4=IR Tx, 5=IR Rx. Shares the same 5-pole captive with the matching RS-232 pass-thru port (pins 1-3).

ports.label: IR Pass-Thru TP Rx 1
ports.notes: IR (TTL 0-5V, 30-60kHz) pass-through over the DTP/XTP/HDBT TP link (to remote sink-side endpoints). Pin 3=Gnd, 4=IR Tx, 5=IR Rx. Shares the same 5-pole captive with the matching RS-232 pass-thru port (pins 1-3).

ports.label: IR Pass-Thru TP Rx 2
ports.notes: IR (TTL 0-5V, 30-60kHz) pass-through over the DTP/XTP/HDBT TP link (to remote sink-side endpoints). Pin 3=Gnd, 4=IR Tx, 5=IR Rx. Shares the same 5-pole captive with the matching RS-232 pass-thru port (pins 1-3).

ports.label: EXP Bus
ports.notes: Extron proprietary EXP audio expansion bus on RJ-45. 16ch Tx + 16ch Rx, 24-bit/48kHz uncompressed. Links a second Extron DSP for I/O expansion. Shielded CAT 6 up to 10m. Modeled as `aes` + `rj45` per project convention (no `extron-exp` SignalType).

ports.label: USB (Front)
ports.notes: Front-panel USB Mini-B for direct switcher configuration via PC. USB 2.0 low speed.

ports.label: AC Mains
ports.notes: Internal universal-input PSU. 100-240 VAC, 50-60 Hz, IEC C14 inlet.
